name: Pneumatic gripper
mounting_basis: Rebase the original assembly rear face (source Z = -36 mm) to body Z = 0. Mount that face 15 mm behind the standard flange reference, preserving the approximately 1 mm housing clearance of the shared tool interface on both arms.
tcp_basis: Legacy MHZ2-10D RCB DH reference (a = -45.25 mm, d = -62.8 mm), carried with the source geometry through rebasing and mounting. Not a newly measured grasp center.
motion_basis: Local PAROL6 API pneumatic vertical motion definition: symmetric 3.5 mm per jaw. Source mesh is open at q = 0; positive joint displacement closes each jaw. Nominal modeled inner clearance changes from about 7.1 mm to 0.1 mm.
mass_status: Unverified legacy RCB MHZ2-10D total, explicitly marked TODO in the upstream configuration. Not a user measurement.
mass_distribution: Distribute the estimated total by solid CAD volume; compute local COM and central inertia from each rigid part at that uniform density. These are simulation estimates, not measured mass properties.
actuation_status: Finite force-limited jaw servo approximating valve open/close endpoints. No air pressure, compressibility, valves, or measured pressure-to-force behavior is simulated.
